QuestInfo.name: Arkarium's End
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #p1103006# to find out what your last mission is.
QuestInfo.1: You must enter the #m272030400# through the secret passage and defeat Arkarium to prevent the Black Mage's return!
QuestInfo.2: You prevented Arkarium's attempt to resurrect the Black Mage! \nInform Neinheart in Ereve.

0.0: I think you're really tough enough to beat up Arkarium! If you can take the #bSecret Passage#k, you should be able to get to his altar. This is what we're all working for! This is the safety of Maple World!

yes.0: You can do it! Even though you'll probably end up getting turned into a toad or something. Those wizard-types just scare my hat off!

no.0: Oh well. I guess Neinheart will want ME to do it. I wish I wasn't such a wimp, but I'll give it a shot!

1.0: Woah, you're back in one piece! Did you beat Arkarium up?!

yes.0: Neinheart will want to know how you did!

mob.0: The Dimensional Schism still seems to be leaking dark energy into our world. That means Arkarium is still in there! Can you take him down?
